brique._comment: Engine-native Matter family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: matter.exists
objective.description: Answer whether a matter currently exists in the local matter catalog.

#root.role: Resolve one matter identifier against the local runtime catalog and return an explicit existence answer.

transformation_contract.morphing: A matter identifier becomes an explicit existence statement against the current local matter catalog.
invariants: matter.exists performs a catalog lookup only and does not read matter substance or descriptor files.
The response is limited to the addressed matter identifier and a boolean existence answer.
success: A successful response always returns the requested matter_id and an exist boolean.
The response remains successful whether the catalog contains the matter or not.
failure: The capacity fails when matter_id is missing.
The capacity fails only when the runtime cannot evaluate the local catalog lookup.
notes: An absent matter is reported as exist=false, not as a refused business outcome.
This capacity is intended for cheap existence checks before heavier read or write flows.
